tolerance.rule: an agent and reward match under a variant when both the mean and the population standard deviation are within tolerance of the published values; absolute differences only; no post hoc tolerance change; exact maximum differences and failing agents are reported even when no variant matches
tolerance.tolerance_basis: runs/ope_corrected_v2/reference_comparison.json registers no tolerance; 1e-4 is about 30 times the largest minimum-action residual recorded there and about 85 times smaller than the largest progress residual, so it separates numerical residue from unexplained differences
